text: The word "Biodegradable" consists of the prefix "Bio-" (meaning life or living organisms), the root "degrade" (meaning to break down or deteriorate), and the suffix "-able" (meaning capable of being). The phrase "break down" is a phrasal verb where "break" is the root verb and "down" is a particle. "Materials" consists of the root "material" and the plural suffix "-s". "Naturally" consists of the root "natural" and the adverbial suffix "-ly". "Environment" consists of the root "environ" (to surround) and the noun-forming suffix "-ment". "Remind" consists of the prefix "re-" (again) and the root "mind" (to keep in memory). "Monday" is a compound word from "Mon" (Moon) and "day".
